title: Sad Red Hot Chili Peppers News
htmlContent:
The Red Hot Chili Peppers' story is filled with many ups and downs. The biggest issue that the Red Hot Chili Peppers had endured through their storied career was addiction.

When we take a look back at the timeline of the Chili Peppers, we can see how many times the band had almost come to an end due to the issues that plagued the band and nearly every single member that had stepped foot into the shoes of the ethos that was the band.

The first tragedy struck when Hillel Slovak passed away from addiction. Hillel was the founding guitarist for the funk-punk-pop group. The band was hitting a massive stride before the sad passing of Slovak. After his death, we eventually got to the point in the timeline where John Frusciante would join the band and leave his legacy.

Tragedy would strike again as John would start going through addiction issues as well. Not only would John go through addiction, but the band would almost break up due to Anthony Keidis also going through his own addiction demons. John would leave the band multiple times, and in fact, John has just recently gotten back to the band after stepping away yet again, just a few years ago.

With John coming back, there have been rumors about what was happening behind the scenes. Hillel Slovak's brother has now spoken up about what he believes is true about the behind-the-scenes notions that John Frusciante did in his time away from the Red Hot Chili Peppers.

With a special thanks to Reddit, Slovak stated that not only did he believe that John was still on dope, but he only had two teeth left and will not speak much on camera due to brain damage that had been done due to the years upon years of addiction. You can see his quote via the above Reddit link.
